memories.author: patient
memories.text: I am a 76-year-old woman who works as a school bus driver and lives in Rajajinagar, Bengaluru. I was told I have fatty liver disease and currently take silymarin 140 mg three times daily and rosuvastatin 5 mg each morning. I want to keep walking independently and avoid any falls that could stop me from working.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: reports independent ambulation, manages bus route without assistance, no difficulty with ADLs.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (recall 3 items, clock draw normal), negative screen.
falls: denies falls in past year, gait steady, timed up-and-go 9 seconds (normal).
medicines: 2 regular (silymarin, rosuvastatin); not polypharmacy.
mood: denies low mood or anxiety, reports good sleep.
carers: daughter Priya, provides occasional help with groceries.
goal: "I wish to stay active on my bus route and keep my liver healthy."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
silymarin 140 mg tablet, take one tablet three times daily.
rosuvastatin 5 mg tablet, take one tablet once daily.

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
ALT 48 U/L (7-35), AST 42 U/L (8-33), ALP 92 U/L (40-129), GGT 55 U/L (9-48).
Total bilirubin 0.9 mg/dL (0.2-1.2).
Platelet count 210 x10^9/L (150-400).
Fasting lipid profile: cholesterol 190 mg/dL (<200), triglycerides 160 mg/dL (<150), HDL 48 mg/dL (>40), LDL 102 mg/dL (<100).

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Abdominal ultrasound: liver shows diffuse hyperechoic parenchyma consistent with steatosis, no focal lesion, spleen normal, portal vein patent, no ascites. Impression: grade 1 non-alcoholic fatty liver disease.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: continues to drive bus route, reports mild fatigue after long shifts but otherwise independent.
cognition: Mini-Cog repeated, score 3/5 (recall 2 items, clock draw mild abnormality), negative.
falls: no falls, gait slightly slower, timed up-and-go 10 seconds (normal).
medicines: 2 regular (silymarin, rosuvastatin); not polypharmacy.
mood: occasional irritability, denies depression.
carers: daughter Priya, assists with medication pickup.
goal: "I want to keep working and feel less tired during my shifts."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
silymarin 140 mg tablet, take one tablet three times daily.
rosuvastatin 5 mg tablet, take one tablet once daily (dose unchanged).

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
ALT 62 U/L (7-35), AST 55 U/L (8-33), ALP 100 U/L (40-129), GGT 70 U/L (9-48).
Total bilirubin 1.0 mg/dL (0.2-1.2).
Platelet count 205 x10^9/L (150-400).
Fasting lipid profile: cholesterol 205 mg/dL (<200), triglycerides 180 mg/dL (<150), HDL 46 mg/dL (>40), LDL 112 mg/dL (<100).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: reports mild shortness of breath on exertion, still drives bus but takes breaks.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 2/5 (recall 1 item, clock draw abnormal), positive screen – plan for MoCA assessment.
falls: one fall at home slipping on wet floor, no injury; gait unsteady, timed up-and-go 13 seconds (raised fall risk) – advise strength exercises and supportive footwear.
medicines: 2 regular (silymarin, rosuvastatin); not polypharmacy.
mood: feels low after fall, denies hopelessness.
carers: daughter Priya, now helps with home safety.
goal: "I want to regain my strength and avoid any more falls."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
silymarin 140 mg tablet, take one tablet three times daily (continue).
rosuvastatin 5 mg tablet, take one tablet once daily (continue).
vitamin E 400 IU softgel, take one capsule daily (added for antioxidant support).

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
ALT 55 U/L (7-35), AST 48 U/L (8-33), ALP 95 U/L (40-129), GGT 60 U/L (9-48).
Total bilirubin 0.9 mg/dL (0.2-1.2).
Platelet count 200 x10^9/L (150-400).
Fasting lipid profile: cholesterol 198 mg/dL (<200), triglycerides 150 mg/dL (<150), HDL 48 mg/dL (>40), LDL 100 mg/dL (<100).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: able to drive bus route with occasional rest, reports improved energy.
cognition: MoCA performed, score 24/30 (mild impairment), stable.
falls: no further falls, gait firmer, timed up-and-go 11 seconds (normal).
medicines: 3 regular (silymarin, rosuvastatin, vitamin E); not polypharmacy.
mood: reports better mood, enjoys time with grandchildren.
carers: daughter Priya, continues to assist with meds.
goal: "I wish to keep my liver numbers steady and stay active for my family."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
silymarin 140 mg tablet, take one tablet three times daily (continue).
rosuvastatin 5 mg tablet, discontinue – liver enzymes stable, statin not needed.
vitamin E 400 IU softgel, take one capsule daily (continue).
omega-3 fatty acids 1000 mg capsule, take two capsules daily (added for lipid support).
